# Cloud Notepad

Cloud Notepad is a collaborative note-taking application that syncs notes across all your devices.

## Features

- Real-time collaboration with cursors and comments
- Markdown editing with live preview
- Offline mode with automatic sync
- End-to-end encryption

## Install

```bash
npm install -g cloud-notepad
```

## Usage

```bash
cloud-notepad serve --port 3000
```
